audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Shen levels 3, 4-5, first item and two items in both layers, while every corresponding whys[] line says Ryze wins those stages and the matchup runs 53.48% over 359 games. Level 1 was credited to Ryze although whys[0] says to farm and take nothing.
audit.why: Shen is immobile against a root, Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks and not spells, and Ryze out-scales a non-scaling tank at every item step. Packet chart: Skill then Ryze for all six remaining rows.
audit.corrected: Row 0 -> Skill; rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 6 -> Ryze, as matched full/content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Level 2 (W root vs a dashless tank), level 6 (Realm Warp vs Stand United), and the first mana item are the real spikes and spikes[0..3] already state them.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] described Shen's level 1 as 'Ki Strike autos' and 'his passive energy cycle'. Shen's passive is Ki Barrier — a shield granted after casting a spell, its cooldown reduced by affecting champions — and his Q is Twilight Assault, max-health damage. No page text gave Shadow Dash's cost or cooldown despite the whole page being keyed to it.
audit.why: Ki Barrier means every Shen cast comes with a shield, so poke that trades into a fresh cast is wasted; and Shadow Dash at 18/16/14/12/10 on 150 energy is the actual window the advice tells you to count.
audit.corrected: whys[0], dosFull[0].d and report[5].t rewritten with the real passive, the real Q name, and Shadow Dash's numbers plus the Spirit's Refuge attacks-only rule.

edits.before: Shen's level 1 is Ki Strike autos and Q poke — you have only Q and no root yet, so farming safely at max Q range stops his passive energy cycle from chunking you for a free early lead.
edits.after: Shen's level 1 is Twilight Assault (Q) max-health chip with Ki Barrier shielding him after every cast — you have only Q and no root, so farm at max Q range and give him nothing to trade into.

edits.before: His taunt engage — punish hard while it is on cooldown. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Shadow Dash is 18s at rank 1 and costs 150 energy — step up the moment he spends it.

edits.before: Track Shen’s Shadow Dash (Taunt): His taunt engage — punish hard while it is on cooldown. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Track Shen’s Shadow Dash: 18s at rank 1, 150 energy, 600 range — and Spirit's Refuge blocks attacks only, never your spells.
